name: IIRM Holdings India Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, IIRM Holdings India
Ltd is in the business of consultancy and investments in group /associates companies[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] IIRM Holdings India Limited (formerly Sudev Industries) is a diversified insurance distribution platform with over 25 years of operational history. It operates across India, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Kenya and has evolved from an insurance agency to a licensed broker offering comprehensive insurance solutions, reinsurance services, and wellness offerings.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
